description: NaYTa(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R3c space group. Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.67 Å) and three longer (2.70 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Y is bonded to six O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.15 Å) and three longer (2.21 Å) Y-O bond lengths. Ta is bonded to six O atoms to form TaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (2.01 Å) and three longer (2.04 Å) Ta-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent TaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-36°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.61 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Y and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Ta and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ta, and one P atom.
